response.justification: Despite extensive experience as a senior software developer, the candidate lacks Java-specific project experience, has only basic German language skills (a hard requirement), and is significantly overqualified for an entry-level role, raising concerns about retention and alignment with junior responsibilities.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong track record in open-source contributions and technical workshops
Demonstrated proficiency in agile practices, CI/CD, and cloud technologies
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, failing the mandatory requirement
No visible Java project work despite listing it as a skill
Senior-level experience makes this a poor fit for an entry-level position
